standard.summary: LyCORIS 提供多种替代 LoRA 的低秩适配器算法：LoHa（Hadamard 积）、LoKr（Kronecker 积）、IA³（特征调制）、Diag-OFT（正交微调）、LoCon（卷积扩展 LoRA）。
standard.effect: 不同算法在参数效率、表达能力和文件大小上各有优劣。LoHa 和 LoKr 通常比标准 LoRA 质量更高但文件更大。IA³ 参数最少但表达能力有限。
standard.whenToUse: LoHa/LoKr 在追求最高质量时推荐。IA³ 在极小文件需求时使用。LoCon 在需要卷积层适配时使用。
standard.avoidWhen: 不确定时用标准 LoRA——兼容性最好，工具链支持最完善。

optionDescriptions.locon: 线性和卷积都挂，纹理强一点，体积也大。
optionDescriptions.loha: Hadamard，同参数往往比 LoRA 丰。
optionDescriptions.ia3: 通道缩放，改动小才合适。

standard_en.summary: LyCORIS offers several low-rank adapter algorithms as alternatives to LoRA: LoHa (Hadamard product), LoKr (Kronecker product), IA3 (feature modulation), Diag-OFT (orthogonal finetuning) and LoCon (LoRA extended to convolutions).
standard_en.effect: The algorithms trade off parameter efficiency, expressive power and file size differently. LoHa and LoKr are usually higher quality than a standard LoRA but produce larger files. IA3 uses the fewest parameters but its expressive power is limited.
standard_en.whenToUse: LoHa/LoKr are recommended when you are after the highest quality. IA3 when you need an extremely small file. LoCon when the convolution layers need adapting.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When unsure use the standard LoRA -- the best compatibility and the most complete tool-chain support.

optionDescriptions.locon: Hooks both linear and convolution layers: a little stronger on texture, and larger.
optionDescriptions.loha: Hadamard; at the same parameter count it is often richer than LoRA.
optionDescriptions.lokr: Kronecker; saves parameters, but do not take factor to an extreme.
optionDescriptions.ia3: Channel scaling; only suitable when the change is small.

advanced.principle: LoHa: ΔW = (A⊙B)·(C⊙D)，用 Hadamard 积表达更丰富的权重更新。LoKr: ΔW = A⊗B，Kronecker 积在保持参数量的同时表达力更强。lycoris_lokr_factor 控制 Kronecker 分解比例。IA³: 只学习 per-channel 缩放向量。Diag-OFT: 对权重施加正交变换。lycoris_conv_dim/conv_alpha 控制卷积层的独立 rank。
advanced.intervention: network_module 设为 lycoris.locon 时激活 LyCORIS 注入，lycoris_algo 选择具体算法。
advanced.expectedImpact: LoHa/LoKr 比标准 LoRA 质量提升约 3-10%，但文件体积可能增加 2-4 倍。
advanced.tradeoffs: lycoris_train_norm 允许训练 LayerNorm 层。lycoris_use_effective_conv 为兼容性保留：本项目 LoHa 的 effective-conv 优化已由 Khatri-Rao 因子化路径等效替代（见 lycoris_loha），该字段不改变计算；卷积层适配请用 lycoris.locon。

advanced_en.principle: LoHa: ΔW = (A⊙B)·(C⊙D), using Hadamard products for richer weight updates. LoKr: ΔW = A⊗B — the Kronecker product is more expressive at equal parameter count. lycoris_lokr_factor controls the Kronecker factorization ratio. IA³: learns only per-channel scaling vectors. Diag-OFT: applies orthogonal transforms to weights. lycoris_conv_dim/conv_alpha control independent ranks for conv layers.
advanced_en.intervention: LyCORIS injection activates when network_module is lycoris.locon, with lycoris_algo choosing the algorithm.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: LoHa/LoKr improve quality about 3-10% over standard LoRA, but file size may grow 2-4×.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: lycoris_train_norm allows training LayerNorm layers. lycoris_use_effective_conv is kept for compatibility: this project's LoHa effective-conv optimization has been equivalently replaced by the Khatri-Rao factorized path (see lycoris_loha), and the field no longer changes computation; use lycoris.locon for conv-layer adaptation.
